sections.heading: Carried by more than one source

items.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the general availability of OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra on Amazon Bedrock. GPT-6.1 Terra expands the GPT-6 family with a balance of capability, speed, and cost efficiency for everyday workloads.

items.title: Cloudflare and VoidZero Introduce tsrs: an AI-Generated Rust Port of TypeScript
items.blurb: Cloudflare, VoidZero and Max Schwenk announced tsrs, an experimental Rust port of the TypeScript compiler, built with the TypeScript team's involvement.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock expands API support and introduces Cross-Region Inferencing for OpenAI models in AWS GovCloud (US)
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock now supports the OpenAI GPT-5.6 models (Terra and Luna) on the bedrock-runtime endpoint, with support for the Responses, Converse, and Chat Completions APIs in AWS GovCloud (US).

items.title: Web Search now available on Kiro in AWS GovCloud (US)
items.blurb: Kiro web search gives the agent real-time access to current information on the internet, so its answers draw on up-to-date search results and page content.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer automatically saves in-progress emails as drafts
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer automatically saves in-progress emails as drafts, helping agents resume work without losing progress when connectivity is interrupted or when their browser is accidentally closed or refreshed.

items.title: AWS Capacity Largely Sold Out Through 2027, With On Demand Headroom Reserved
items.blurb: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says AWS’s large committed cloud capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with part of 2028 already allocated, while the company continues to reserve headroom for On Demand, EC2 and Bedrock.

items.title: File Mover Express: AWS Releases Open-Source Tool for S3 File Transfers
items.blurb: AWS has recently released File Mover Express, an open-source application under the Apache 2.0 license for transferring large files between local systems and Amazon S3.

items.title: Cloudflare’s Post-Quantum GeoKey Manager Enters Closed Beta Without Attribute-Based Encryption
items.blurb: Cloudflare has moved a post-quantum rebuild of GeoKey Manager into closed beta, guarding geo-fenced keys with hybrid ML-KEM-768 and X25519 instead of the attribute-based encryption used since 2022.
